pages.text: The Potion Protection Poppet protects you from all negative potion effects, except the wither effect. $(br)If you are subjected to any negative effect the poppet will try to fully negate it. Each level of the effect will require one durability point. $(br)If there are not enough durability points on all your Potion Protection Poppets left it will only reduce the level accordingly.

pages.title: Uses and Effects
pages.text: Six durability. Removing a harmful effect costs its level in points; Wither needs its own poppet. Also protects against damage from thrown potions and area-effect clouds.
